test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Sree Narayana Guru considered the differences based on caste and religion as meaningless and advocated the principle of ‘One Caste, one Religion and one God’ for all. He belonged to which of the following organisations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sree Narayana Guru was a** social reformer and spiritual leader** who played a significant role in **changing the social structure of Kerala in the early 20th century**.
 
• He **founded the Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam (SNDP Yogam)** to promote spiritual enlightenment and social equality.
 
• His philosophy of **'One Caste, One Religion, and One God for all'** aimed at eliminating the caste system and promoting a universal religion.
 
• Through his efforts, he contributed to the opening of temples for all castes, education for everyone, and fought against caste discrimination.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Veda Samaj
 A reform movement similar in its aims to Brahmo Samaj, focused on reforming Hindu society and religion.
 
 

 Brahmo Samaj
 A socio-religious reform movement in India, **founded by Raja Ram Mohan Roy**, aiming at the purification of Hinduism and promoting monotheism.
 
 

 Arya Samaj
 **Founded by Swami Dayanand Saraswati**, aiming at the revival of Vedic ideologies and reforming Hindu society by eliminating caste discrimination and promoting gender equality.
